notes: DiscoFlate v3.45.0 — the Chat tab: a live mirror of any watched channel (bot posts included, history backfill) with a send box that posts as the bot or runs !commands AS THE OWNER (cooldown-exempt, owner-only allowed), plus the operator controls one click away. Video foundation: voice/stage channels can be watched (🔊 in pickers); selecting one reveals the 🎥 section with an OBS-style VIRTUAL CAMERA (webcam → overlay compositor → a device you pick in Discord) and Overlay actions — buttons that play timed image layers over your live feed (full overlay/scene system coming). Launchers now self-heal pip (corpse cleanup, cache purge + retry, real error logs). Desktop camera deps auto-install; Windows needs OBS once for its virtual-cam driver.
